labels.claim_text: Valve IV-RB3-17 sealing condition unknown; lack of evidence for seal may indicate loss of pressure.
labels.reason: a question about whether the valve bled through

labels.claim_text: Local isolation at valve IV-RB3-17 recorded; could have caused loss of hydraulic pressure in carrier yokes.
labels.reason: valve closed is the backup raise being 'isolated'

labels.claim_text: Outage switching sheet does not record pressure on isolated cylinder side of valve IV-RB3-17.
labels.reason: pressure on the isolated side not checked: stored energy not accounted for

labels.claim_text: The keeper plate was not broken or displaced at the time of the carrier fall.
labels.reason: keeper still bolted or intact

labels.claim_text: Recovered link arm inspection shows keeper plate bolted and no gross fracture.
labels.reason: keeper still bolted or intact

labels.claim_text: The keeper plate remained attached and not fractured at the time of the carrier fall.
labels.reason: keeper still bolted or intact

labels.reason: keeper still bolted or intact
